description_en: Triggers the specified data quality scan and returns the run ID
description_zh: 触发指定数据质量监控任务的执行，并返回运行实例ID
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-quality-scan-run --data-quality-scan-id 20000001 --project-id 10000 --parameters Value=1775812636 Name=triggerTime --runtime-resource Cu=0.25 Id=e9455a13-ff00-4965-833c-337546ba4854 Image=i-xxxxxx --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataQualityScanRun

fields.help_en:
The parameter value.

If the parameter name is triggerTime, this value must be the trigger time as a timestamp
fields.help_zh:
参数值：
当参数名为triggerTime时，参数值应为调度时间的时间戳
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The name of the parameter. The only supported value is:

triggerTime

No other scheduling parameters are currently supported
fields.help_zh:
参数名，目前支持参数为：
triggerTime

暂不支持其它调度参数
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The parameters for the run. The `triggerTime` parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 实际运行时，使用的参数设置，其中必传参数`triggerTime`
parameters.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The number of compute units (CUs) to reserve from the resource group for the data quality scan
fields.help_zh: 资源组运行数据质量监控时预留的CU配置
fields.name: cu

fields.help_en: The image configuration for running the data quality scan on the resource group
fields.help_zh: 使用资源组运行数据质量监控时的镜像设置
fields.name: image

parameters.help_en: Specifies the scheduling resource group used to run the data quality scan. This object uses the same data structure as the scheduling API
parameters.help_zh: 数据质量监控运行时，所使用的调度资源组，与调度API共用相同的数据结构
parameters.name: runtime_resource
